changelog:
• Ambient Screensaver Crash Fix: Resolved Google TV / Android TV screensaver sleep timeout during continuous video playback by engaging native window keep-screen-on and persistent wake-locks across all platforms.
• Leanback Orientation Stability: Strictly locked Leanback TV devices to landscape orientations, preventing activity destruction on player entrance/exit.
• ExoPlayer Robustness: Complete exception isolation on ExoPlayer event loop with graceful completion handling.
• Instant Live Sports Recovery: Bypassed movie VOD resolver on live sports reconnects, auto-advancing to live mirrors seamlessly.
• Player Engine Resource Shield: Explicit MediaKit stream listener cleanup and safe controller teardown to eliminate memory leaks.
